items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Jim Robinson was in charge, Jim Robinson was in charge, but I was the leader and so forth of that group.

ctx.x: Which is Big Jim? Big Jim? Yeah, who is he?
Jim Robinson. I wanted you to tell me. Jim Robinson.
And Little Jim we know who that is. Sidney Brown. Did they have a piano in those kind of jobs?
